One page per dataset the lab collects or uses. Each page is a dataset card: what the data holds, where it lives, who can access it, and how far it has been processed.

Never put participant data in this repository. Link to where the data lives.

## Overview

| Collection | What it holds |
|---|---|
| [Breast imaging datasets](breast-imaging.qmd) | Nine public mammography datasets (EMBED, VinDr-Mammo, M-SYNTH, CMMD, and others): size of our copy, source, and labels |

To add a dataset, copy `datasets/_template.qmd`.
